UserStudioSettings.title: UserStudioSettings
UserStudioSettings.description: Authenticated user's Clarion studio profile and active interviewer/model preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

activeModelId.description: Currently selected model preset ID or model name.

voiceAutoPlay.description: Whether interviewer replies auto-speak via voice synthesis.

searchGrounding.description: Whether Google Search grounding is enabled for Gemini models.

InterviewerPersona.title: InterviewerPersona
InterviewerPersona.description: Custom or customized realistic interviewer avatar with preloaded personality characteristics.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

styleTag.description: Short style tag shown on persona card.

followUpDepth.description: Depth of probing follow-ups from 0 to 100.

systemPrompt.description: Detailed realistic behavioral instructions for the interviewer.

presetDrawableKey.description: Key for bundled photorealistic avatar drawable.

localPortraitFile.description: Optional filename of runtime AI-generated portrait stored locally on device.

ModelPreset.title: ModelPreset
ModelPreset.description: User-configured AI model preset supporting any Gemini model ID or custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

label.description: Human-friendly label for the model preset.

baseUrl.description: Custom endpoint URL for OpenAI-compatible models (empty for Gemini).

InterviewSession.title: InterviewSession
InterviewSession.description: Recorded interview session metadata and executive evaluation scorecard.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

targetRole.description: Job title or scenario the candidate is interviewing for.

turnCount.description: Number of conversation turns in the session.

summaryFeedback.description: Executive summary feedback generated at session completion.

strengths.description: List of up to 10 key strengths.

improvements.description: List of up to 10 actionable improvements.

InterviewMessage.title: InterviewMessage
InterviewMessage.description: Single immutable transcript turn within an interview session.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

modelUsed.description: Model ID that generated this turn (empty for candidate turns).

hasAttachment.description: Whether the turn included a multimodal resume/image/video attachment.

attachmentLabel.description: Short label of attached media if present.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user Clarion studio profile and preferences.

/users/{userId}/personas/{personaId}.description: Per-user custom and customized interviewer avatars.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Per-user interview sessions and executive scorecards.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}/mes.description: Ordered immutable transcript messages for an interview session.
